description.subtitle: First Team T-shirt Mohammed Salah Puma of Egypt 2026 selection - red
description.intro: The Puma Egypt 2026 T-shirt from local combines tradition and modernity in a design inspired by the rich cultural history of the country. Its intense red color is complemented by a frontal graphic that evokes iconic symbols, representing the strength and legacy of the Pharaohs.
key_benefits: Historical inspiration: Design that pays tribute to the Egyptian cultural legacy.
Light comfort: Breathable fabric that favors comfort.
Modern Style: Frontal Graphic that provides depth and character.
Official identity: National team crest and Puma logo.
